units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 30b:13">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שאינו … מלמדו ל׳</he> whosoever does not teach him (his son) a trade, trains him for robbery; a. e.—Pl. <he>לִיסְטִיּו̇ת</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 25b:6">Yeb. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>נתפס ע״י ל׳</he> he was arrested on account of robberies (that had been committed).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:5">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>יצא לל׳</he> turned to lawlessness; (Ms. M. <he>ללִיסְטְיָא</he> = λῃστεία).
